description: The Nimiq validator pools of the current epoch, ranked neutrally, exactly as the NimBooks app ranks them: producing pools first (those with a reliability score this epoch), best net annual yield first within them, pools that publish no yield last, then the non-producing pools, and the name as the final stable tiebreak. Nothing is pinned first. Read-only: one call to the public validators list, never signs and never sends. netYieldPercent is the net annual yield on the network's total stake after the pool's fee, the Nimiq wallet's convention; it moves as emission falls and as stake moves.

includeNonProducing.description: Include pools with no reliability score this epoch (they earn nothing right now). Default true.

name: list_validators
title: Nimiq validator pools
